title: Best Prime Day 2026 Tech Deals Under $100: Save Up to 75% on Bose, Beats by Dre, Samsung & Other Top Brands
summary: Upgrading your home audio? During Prime Day, Amazon has deep discounts on headphones, earbuds, speakers, turntables & other gear, sitewide.
contentText:
All products and services featured are independently chosen by editors. However, Billboard may receive a commission on orders placed through its retail links, and the retailer may receive certain auditable data for accounting purposes.

Prime Day starts Tuesday (June 23) and goes until Friday (June 26). During the four-day shopping event, Amazon marks down nearly every category — including sound gear and home audio. Now is the best time to upgrade your home audio setup, or just grab a new pair of noise-canceling headphones for your daily commute for cheap.

With savings up to a whopping 75%, Billboard Shopping rounded up the best deals on all sorts of tech and home audio gear for Prime Day . There are deep discounts on top brands, like Bose, Google, Beats by Dre, Razer and others. Best of all? All deals found are $100 or less, at the time of publishing.

Shop 2026 Prime Day Deals on Amazon

And because these deals are during Prime Day, you’ll need to be an Amazon Prime member to activate the savings.

But act fast and shop now, these deals are only active for a limited time and expire by Friday (June 26) on Amazon.
